name: Yamazaki Hibiki
source:
【The Cute and Charming Married Woman Next Door】
A married woman whose husband is working elsewhere while she holds the fort down at home.
Now that she has to handle everything by herself, she is filled with even more love and appreciation for her husband.
Since she has some more free time on her hands, she has taken to baking sweets recently.
An earnest and accepting woman.

「Nice to meet you. My name is Hibiki Yamazaki, from next door」
